title: Stage 3 marketing-engine art direction (model output). Code validates and clamps every value; the model never renders the product or any text.

mood.description: One coherent campaign mood shared by every image.

palette.description: Environment palette that flatters the approved artwork's colours.

lighting.description: Shared lighting idea (e.g. warm window light, candlelight).

slides.description: One art direction for each slide id given, and no others.

archetype.description: Composition: where the product sits (right/left/centre) and the copy goes opposite or above. Use only archetypes allowed for the engine.

product_scale.description: Share of the square frame the real product should cover (the product must dominate).

perspective.description: Product tilt towards the camera in degrees.

enum: warm window light from the left
warm window light from the right

decor.description: Coded decorative layer (never drawn by the image model).

scene_brief.description: ENVIRONMENT only: surface, props, depth, light, colour, with a clear empty area where the product will be placed. Never a card, paper, book, print, page, screen, text, lettering, logo, frame, person, hand or animal.

lines.description: One supporting line for each tone slide id given, and no others.

text.description: One warm, short supporting line in UK English, sentence case. No claims beyond the facts.
